# Outlook-safe Background

`email/outlook-safe-background` &middot; section-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

A section with a background photo and a VML fallback so it also shows in Outlook desktop.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | url |  |
| `content` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Photo behind centered content, on the primary color when blocked.
- **tinted**: Falls back to the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.3xl @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background image via VML. | Background images can be dropped, the solid color shows. | Keeps its own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/outlook-safe-background', {
  "image": "https://placehold.co/1200x600/png?text=Photo",
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "Find your summer uniform"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h2",
        "align": "center",
        "color": "@colors.primaryText",
        "darkMode": false
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/button",
      "data": {
        "label": "Shop the collection",
        "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
      },
      "settings": {
        "background": "@colors.primaryText",
        "color": "@colors.primary",
        "darkMode": "none"
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):
